subject: CardBench kickoff - benchmark backbone for learned cardinality estimation
body:
Team,

Kicking off CardBench adoption. Goal: make our open-source benchmark for learned cardinality estimation the standard eval for the query-optimizer track, so model teams stop inventing their own workloads. CardBench has two halves - the pre-built training datasets and the code that produces them - and the paper's key convenience is that the training query graphs can be consumed directly without running any CardBench code. That's the fast path I want most internal users on.

Milestones: (1) Feb 27 - query graphs ingested and documented for internal use; (2) Mar 27 - one reference cardinality model trained and evaluated end to end; (3) May 15 - the full re-generation pipeline (downsampled databases, table stats collection, workload generation) running on our infra, ahead of a Q2 review.

Daniela, over to you for staffing and the Corpus dependency plan.

Dmitri
